2ae5ca1e with a rate built from 60 and 0.1 is probably a smoothing step toward the firing target; not decoded.

leads.title: Agile Shooter and LMG sprint exemption: upgrade checks in the movement-speed logic
leads.summary: On 2.1.1.0 (resource 0550f387167b0bdd, captured 9 November) SimEx_MoveSpeedModifiers checks four upgrades: Ability_SupportTrait skips the LMG x0.95 sprint penalty, Ability_Commando_Base (Agile Shooter) skips the x0.8 firing multiplier (walk 2.8 to 3.5 m/s), Ability_MedicalTriage and Ability_SwiftTriage select the dragging modifier. Logic and constants equal 1.4.3.5; id-to-check pairing is by order with four semantic matches.
leads.reopenWhen: A game update changes the movement resource, or an in-game firing-walk or LMG-sprint comparison disagrees.
